d_preserved_statement: Unchanged from implementation_v1.json -- the mechanic itself (contactOrderWins, prerequisite-gated 5-stage flow, one-shot contact taps, randomized display order) was not touched by this repair; impl review r1 found 0 blockers/high against the mechanic itself (batching_bug_absent, position_leak_closed, brute_force_genuinely_closed, gate_h_correct, gate_g_correct, logic_matches_design_sim all confirmed true).

repair_v2_impl_review_r1_findings_addres.CONTENT_MECHANIC_MISMATCH (HIGH): src/data/content/schoolTrip.ts's trip-conductor profession 'what' body said '変更案を作って学校の確認を得たうえで' (creates a change proposal) -- the rebuilt mechanic never has the child draft a proposal; contacting a party IS the proposal (per旅行業法12条の10's代替サービスの手配, already established in fact_sheet_v2.json). Fixed to '当日の運行状況を確認し、見学先・バス・宿へ連絡します。特に宿は連絡が遅れるほど対応が難しくなるため、優先して連絡します。学校の承認を得たうえで、関係先へ確定内容を共有します。' -- describes the actual 3-contact structure and hotel-priority judgment instead. delay-trip experience's seeds list had '変更案を考える' (an unperformed action per this project's rule that seeds must describe only actions actually played) -- replaced with '優先順位を考える' (an action the child genuinely performs: recognizing which of the 3 parties to prioritize).
repair_v2_impl_review_r1_findings_addres.QA_REGRESSION_VACUOUS (MEDIUM): The content regression check only scanned an 800-char slice of the delay-trip experience for OLD free-reorder wording, missing the different stale-content pattern (unperformed change-proposal claim) entirely, and several JSX regression checks used unbounded body-wide regex searches (/isOpened &&\s*\(/, /isContacted \? \(/) that could match anywhere in the file rather than being bound to the actual contact-card rendering block. Fixed: content checks now scan the FULL trip-conductor profession entry and delay-trip experience entry (bounded by adjacent entry ids, not an arbitrary char count), assert both the absence of the stale change-proposal phrasing AND the positive presence of the 3-party/hotel-priority description; JSX checks now extract the exact session.displayOrder.map(...) callback block via string boundaries before searching within it. Verified the new content check actually catches the original regression by reverting schoolTrip.ts and confirming the check fails (git stash test).

low_finding_not_changed: The disclosure buttons show '－' after opening even though openContact/toggleReflect are add-only (no collapse) -- impl review r1 flagged this as LOW (cosmetic honesty of the toggle symbol). This exactly matches HotelReceiveGame.tsx's already-shipped identical pattern (toggleCard is also add-only, also shows '－' post-open with no collapse path), so changing it here would be an inconsistency with established codebase convention rather than a fix. Left as-is per the reviewer's own LOW severity (does not affect disclosure, scoring, or exploit resistance).
